definition: Random key for one tracking-workbook row (P1-### or P2-###). Assigned at random within each project; no linkage file was retained, so keys cannot be traced to study IDs.
Project 1 (Activity and Movement Monitoring in Peri-Operative Setting, STEP) or Project 2 (Ambulation and Cognition after Cardiac Surgery, ACCS).
Device model recorded in the tracking workbook; workbook rows without a usable model are labeled as such.

success = REDCap accepted the import and readback matched; validation-fail = excluded at input checks; login-fail = no usable stored token; redcap-map-error = REDCap record lookup failed before import.
How the Garmin session was restored: seeded-token (saved token file) or memory-cache (session already open in the run). Blank when the row did not reach login.
Whether REDCap accepted the import request.

Number of submitted Project 1 fields or Project 2 rows that failed readback comparison.
Wall time to restore the saved Garmin session.

Time to select preoperative and postoperative days and build the project-specific REDCap payload. For Project 2 this includes redcap_existing_read_seconds.
Project 2 only: time to export existing daily repeating instances so they can be reused. Zero for Project 1.

Wall time for post-import REDCap readback comparison.

Number of calendar dates requested from Garmin for the record.

Run-level totals for the September 28, 2026 combined execution. Garmin and REDCap totals are reported on the Overall row; throttle sleep was 0 because request pacing was disabled for this run.
